immersive_simulation.label: Immersive Candidate Simulation
immersive_simulation.description: Roleplay a coherent, realistic candidate persona with consistent simulated scenarios and persistent numerical modeling for mock interview practice.

authentic_preparation.label: Authentic Candidate Preparation
authentic_preparation.description: Ground responses strictly in documented experience, candidate-confirmed facts, transferable expertise, calculations, and transparent assumptions without presenting invented history as personal fact.

technical_deep_dive.label: Technical Deep Dive
technical_deep_dive.description: Prioritize implementation specifics, configuration, architecture, failure modes, validation, and deep follow-up consistency.

recruiter_screening.label: Recruiter Screening
recruiter_screening.description: Prioritize concise career narrative, motivation, core qualifications, and accessible technical framing.

hiring_manager.label: Hiring Manager Interview
hiring_manager.description: Balance individual ownership, engineering judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and business priorities.

behavioral.label: Behavioral Interview
behavioral.description: Communicate implicit STAR stories with clear personal ownership, realistic trade-offs, failures, and lessons learned.

system_design.label: System Design Interview
system_design.description: Drive requirements, scale, availability, security, component interactions, trade-offs, operational complexity, and failure handling.

executive.label: Executive Interview
executive.description: Lead with business outcomes, strategic trade-offs, financial impact, risk management, and executive-grade clarity.

general_cognitive_ability.label: General Cognitive Ability
general_cognitive_ability.description: Apply forward-looking structured reasoning, root-cause prioritization, quantitative sanity checks, and practical phased actions.

presentation_followup.label: Presentation Follow-Up
presentation_followup.description: Deliver crisp 30-45 second answers tied directly to presentation artifacts, business objectives, and architectural decisions.

coaching_evaluation.label: Coaching and Evaluation
coaching_evaluation.description: Break character cleanly to critique candidate/draft answers, inspect evidence gaps, verify math, and recommend concrete improvements.
